name: Message to Freewind Post
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
Brave traveler, the centaurs have increased their attacks in this area. Freewind Post must know about this renewed harassment immediately! Seek Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post to the southeast and give him this urgent message.

Be warned, avoid the Grimtotem Clan nearby... they have been acting strange toward us lately.
narrative.objectives: Bring the Urgent Message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.
narrative.offerRewardText: More bad news! These centaurs have gone too far! They raided one of my supply caravans and slaughtered the whole party. This is an outrage, and it will not go unpunished!
narrative.requestItemsText: What do you want, Champion? An urgent message - for me?

chain.subtitle: 3 quests from level 25 to 28, 4,800 XP in all.

quests.name: Message to Freewind Post
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Urgent Message to Cliffwatcher Longhorn at Freewind Post.

quests.name: Pacify the Centaur
quests.objectiveText: Kill 12 Galak Scouts, 10 Galak Wranglers, and 6 Galak Windchasers, and then return to Cliffwatcher Longhorn in Freewind Post.

quests.name: Grimtotem Spying
quests.objectiveText: Locate and retrieve the three Secret Notes in Darkcloud Pinnacle.
